name: PhysicianBench
description:
# Abstract

PhysicianBench is a benchmark for evaluating large language model (LLM) agents on realistic clinical workflows. The benchmark comprises 100 long-horizon tasks adapted from real consultation cases between primary care physicians and specialists, with each task independently reviewed by a separate panel of physicians. Tasks are instantiated in an EHR environment with real patient records derived from STARR (Stanford Medicine Research Data Repository) and accessed through the same standard APIs used by commercial EHR vendors.

This dataset page hosts only the patient EHR data, distributed as a Docker image bundling a FHIR-compliant EHR server pre-loaded with the de-identified patient cohort. The benchmark task definitions, evaluation harness, and agent framework are released as open source on GitHub (https://github.com/HealthRex/PhysicianBench).

All patient data undergo additional privacy protection measures beyond standard de-identification. Access to the Docker image is provided through a controlled request-and-approval process; data usage is governed by the Stanford University Research Data Use Agreement.

Website: https://healthrex.github.io/PhysicianBench/

# Usage

After download, load the image with:

`gunzip -c physicianbench-fhir-v1.tar.gz | docker load`



The image will appear as `fhir-full:v1`and is consumed by the benchmark scripts at [https://github.com/HealthRex/PhysicianBench](%3Chttps://github.com/HealthRex/PhysicianBench%3E)
